role: records why the authorized evaluation of the seed-4096 and seed-5120 terminal checkpoints did not run, before any release was touched or any checkpoint was opened

authorization_under_which_this_was_attem.understood_as: authorization to evaluate the two new terminal checkpoints against the frozen Development protocol, per-seed gates decided independently, no pooling, both reported regardless of outcome

what_was_done: located the frozen evaluator and its release
inspected the release's consumption state (JSON metadata only)
compared against the PLDM multi-seed precedent
ran the source-rebind auditor, which refused

blocker_1_the_release_is_one_use_and_alr.evaluator_pins_seed_3072_step_1024: the evaluator asserts candidate.seed == 3072 and optimizer_step == 1024, and the terminal identity addendum declares exactly one cell at seed 3072
blocker_1_the_release_is_one_use_and_alr.why_this_blocks: scoring seeds 4096 and 5120 against this release would require either adding candidates after consumption, which the receipt forbids, or re-consuming a one-use release. Both are exactly the thing the exclusive-claim machinery exists to prevent.
blocker_1_the_release_is_one_use_and_alr.why_it_must_not_be_worked_around: the release's evidentiary value comes from having been consumed once, blind, by a preregistered candidate set. Re-opening it would retroactively weaken the seed-3072 result already on record, not just the new one.

blocker_2_the_pinned_source_closure_no_l.live_auditor_verdict: ContractError: ContextWorld HEAD is not the second rebound commit
blocker_2_the_pinned_source_closure_no_l.note: the pinned commit is not on the current history at all, so this is not a fast-forward. The evaluator would refuse for this reason independently of blocker 1.
blocker_2_the_pinned_source_closure_no_l.why_it_must_not_be_worked_around: the source-rebind receipt is what makes the scoring environment reproducible. Repointing it to today's tree would mean the two new seeds were scored in a different environment than seed 3072, which is the one thing a seed replication must not vary.

the_precedent_says_the_same_thing.conclusion: the additional seeds were NOT scored by reusing the spent release. A new one-use release was built, with fresh eval seeds and a fresh bootstrap seed.
the_precedent_says_the_same_thing.v4_also_carried_a_positive_calibration_c: historical-full-delay-PLDM-s3072-step1024, required to pass all four gates on the NEW release, so that a failure of the new seeds could be distinguished from a harder new query set

the_drafting_defect_this_exposes.what_the_preregistration_said: evaluation.protocol = action_delay_h7_a0_aux_pcja_predictor_only_private_development_v1, reused_verbatim = true, 'the same six eval seeds [118..123] ... Nothing in the evaluation is re-tuned for the new seeds.'
the_drafting_defect_this_exposes.why_that_cannot_be_executed_literally: reusing that protocol verbatim means reusing a release that has already been consumed once. The preregistration described the protocol correctly but did not notice that the protocol is embodied in a one-use artifact.
the_drafting_defect_this_exposes.it_is_recorded_here_rather_than_by_editi: the preregistration is frozen by sha256 in the execution authorization

what_a_correct_evaluation_would_require.note: this is a description of the shape of the work, NOT a request to perform it and NOT a preregistration
items: a new one-use Development release for the predictor-only line, with fresh eval seeds and a fresh bootstrap seed, built checkpoint-blind
a positive-calibration candidate scored on the SAME new release, so that a new-seed failure can be distinguished from a harder query set
a source-rebind against a ContextWorld commit that actually exists on the current history, with the environment difference from the seed-3072 scoring disclosed rather than hidden
per-seed independent gate decisions, no pooling, both seeds reported regardless of outcome
what_a_correct_evaluation_would_require.cost_disclosure: this is a substantial build, not a script invocation, and it consumes a Development release that cannot be reused afterwards
